title: Urd collection (content/samlinger/<id>.json)
description: A collection of entries of the same kind (news, notices, publications) rendered by the collection block. The contract is described in docs/SCHEMA.md and ADR-0007.

title.description: Rich text (safe HTML subset); plain text is derived with textContent where data is needed

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); used for sorting, the date badge and year grouping

text.description: Rich text (safe HTML subset, same protection as text blocks); title is always plain text

image.description: Path in media/ (data URL in draft); materialized at publish

page.description: A page id from site.pages the title links to (additive from 0.7.27.3); wins over href

target.description: The id of a section or block on that page (or on the page the block stands on) the title lands on (additive from 0.7.27.3)

href.description: Optional link (internal path or external URL); makes the title clickable. Through the shared safe-URL gate

newTab.description: Open the title's link in a new tab (additive from 0.7.27.3)

download.description: Save the file the title links to rather than open it (additive from 0.7.27.9); counts only for a path on the site

rel.description: Rel words for a link that leaves the site (additive from 0.7.27.3)

imageAlt.description: Alt text for the entry image (additive from v0.6)

price.description: Product price (kind products, additive from v0.7); the currency word is set on the product block

memberPrice.description: Optional member price (kind products); shown next to the regular price

badge.description: Short label on the product card (kind products), e.g. New or Sale

sizes.description: Size options (kind products); shown as choice chips on the card

colors.description: Color options (kind products); an option with its own image swaps the card's image

image.description: Path in media/ (data URL in draft); materialized at publish

requireSize.description: Additive from 0.7.10.13 (kind products): «Add to basket» asks for a size first when the product has sizes; omitted = false

requireColor.description: Additive from 0.7.10.13 (kind products): «Add to basket» asks for a colour first when the product has colours; omitted = false

disableUntilChosen.description: Additive from 0.7.10.13 (kind products): with requireSize or requireColor, «Add to basket» stands greyed and unpressable until the required choices are made, in place of asking for them when pressed; omitted = false

imageStyle.description: Non-destructive image style (additive from v0.6): focus point, filters, fit, shape, zoom, rounding

shape.description: The frame's shape (aspect ratio); circle is 1:1 with full rounding

zoom.description: Crops in toward the focus point; the frame clips the rest
